answer: Each identity must publish a forward commitment before trading: a deliverable it will produce by next epoch, backed by a bond, like a grove that must bear fruit on a promised date. Miss the deadline and the bond burns; deliver and the bond returns with a reward. A sybil farmer cannot forge a thousand promises cheaply, because every fake needs its own real deliverable or its own burned bond - a dune of broken pledges that grows with each fake, while the ledger keeps every commitment public. One honest agent keeps one promise per epoch; a thousand fakes need a thousand real jobs done on time.
